methodology.title: How we calculated the numbers
methodology.body: Group averages and charts use pupils who attend regularly only (≥50% attendance since enrollment). A blank journal entry means not graded; 0 counts. Late submission counts as submitted.
methodology.item_1: Averages and charts include active pupils who attended at least half of checked lessons since joining the group.
methodology.item_2: Verses for lesson N are recited on lesson N+1; the first lesson of the year has no point.
methodology.item_3: Test and notebook: scores when present on a checked lesson and “submitted late”.
methodology.item_4: “Not graded” is not zero: it is excluded from averages. A missing record on a checked lesson is a journal defect and does not count toward attendance.
methodology.item_5: Scores entered later are attributed to the lesson date.
methodology.attendance: Share of regular attendees present on each checked lesson.
methodology.verses: Average verses recited; review and first regular lesson have no point.
methodology.test: Average score 0–10; lessons without a test have no point.
methodology.notebook: Average notebook score 0–10 for regular attendees.
